rationale: This phase executed the full mandated rerun sequence with a real, authorized model credential and a real, independently-dispatched blind second-pass reviewer - not a mock, not a simulation, not an estimate. Every credential-independent, procedural, and regression requirement (items 1-8, 11-18) is satisfied. The two numeric gates that define whether the underlying methodology-validity question is resolved (items 9-10) are both missed. The calibration effort was not a failure in the sense of producing no useful result: binary agreement improved meaningfully (+9 points), the specific false-credit-reproduction risk identified in Phase 3F.1.5 (doc-a::VI::6.10-chapeau) is now demonstrably fixed, and the live-judge confounder is conclusively ruled out as an explanation for the original disagreement. But a new, previously-invisible, and real disagreement about V2's own safe-surfacing threshold was surfaced by the exact vocabulary fix intended to remove noise from the measurement - and per the user's explicit instruction, this result is reported as-is, without any further patch or iteration inside this phase.
